name: General Engineering Public Company Limited
summary: General Engineering Public Company Limited manufactures and sells concrete products in Thailand and internationally. The company offers rectangular, hollow, and I-shape prestressed concrete pile products for use in government units, state enterprises, department stores, factories, universities, airports, housing developments and bridge works, etc.; precast concrete walls that are used in factories, department stores, high-rise buildings, stadiums, etc.; precast concrete slabs without beams for car park buildings and high rise building floors; and semi-finished slabs for use in factory and bridge works. It also provides fiber glass reinforced concrete products; special cement products for use in power plants, petro chemical plants, oil refineries, steel works, paper factories, sugar mills, etc. under the Denka and DENKA Capsule brands; noise barrier products that are used in expressways, highways, underground tunnels, power plants, and factories; and super skim coat for wall decorations. In addition, the company offers post-tension slabs, construction chemicals, electric concrete poles, diaphragm walls, and barrette piles, as well as provides manufacturing and installation services for its products. Further, it distributes steel bars and ready-mixed concrete products that are used in construction, as well as manufactures and sells PC wires and strands. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Pathum Thani, Thailand.
